scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Explicit Cox positive charts of Hirzebruch surfaces over the complex numbers, all nonnegative integral indices; integral homology and generic complex logarithmic critical points only.
scientific_integrity.scientific_limitations: No assertion for all positive sections, other chart choices, non-generic exponents, characteristic-p geometry, or real/positive critical counts. Possible equivalent computation in less directly indexed literature. General Cox-ideal and signed-Euler theorems pre-exist.
scientific_integrity.verification: Self-contained proof plus exact finite arithmetic checks; independent review absent.

title: Parity-sharp critical counts for positive charts of Hirzebruch surfaces
